snippet.title: Leaforia - ANNOUNCEMENT Trailer
snippet.description:
Leaforia is a charming pixel art farming RPG game with deep mechanics, cooperative multiplayer, and a world full of secrets.
Farm, fight, brew magical alcotions, and uncover the mysteries of the Tree of Life!
